6-7. There will be pains in the body if Jupiter be the lord of the 7th (or 2nd).
The remedial measure to obtain relief from the above evil effects and to get fulfilment of ambitions, is recitation of Rudra Japa and Shiva Sahasranam.

metadata.sanskrit: Effects of the Antardasa of Saturn in the Dasa of Jupiter जीवस्यान्तर्गते मन्दे स्वीच्चे स्वक्षेत्रमित्रभे । लग्नात्केन्द्रतिकोणस्थे लाभे वा बलसंपृते ॥दा। राज्यलाभो महत्सीख्यं वस्त्राभरणसंयुतम् । धनधान्यादिलाभश्च स्त्रीलाभो बहुसौख्यकृत् ॥६॥ वाहनाम्बरपश्चादिभूलाभः स्थानलाभकृत् । पुत्रमित्रादिसौख्यं च नरवाहनयोगकृत् ॥१०॥ नीलवस्त्रादिलाभश्च नीलाश्वं लभते च सः । पश्चिमां दिशसाश्चित्य प्रयाणं राजदर्शनम् ॥१९॥ अनेकयानलाभं च निदिशेन्मन्दभृवत् ॥१९॥

document: 8-11½. Effects like acquisition of a kingdom (attainment of high position in government), gain of clothes, ornaments, wealth, grains, conveyances, cattle and position, happiness from some and friends etc., gains specially of a blue coloured horse, journe; to the West, audience with the king and receipt of wealth from him, will be derived in the Antardasa of Saturn in the Dasa of Jupiter, if Saturn be in his sign of exaltation, in his own sign, kendra or trikona endowed with strength.

metadata.sanskrit: लग्नात्वठाष्टमे मन्दे व्यये नीचेऽस्तगेऽप्यरौ॥१२॥ धनधान्यादिनाशस्च ज्वरपीडा मनोरुजः। स्त्रीपुत्राविषु पीडा वा वणात्याविकमुद्भवेत् ॥१३॥ गृहे त्वशुभकार्याणि भृत्यवर्गाविपीडनम् ॥ गोमहिष्याविहानिश्च बन्धृद्वेषी भविष्यति ॥१४॥

document: 12-14. Loss of wealth, affliction with fever, mental agony, infliction of wounds to wife and children, inauspicious events at home, loss of cattle and employment, antagonism with kinsmen, etc., will be results if Saturn be in the 6th, the 8th or the 12th from the Ascendant, be combust or be in an enemy's sign.

metadata.sanskrit: बायेशात्केन्द्रकोणस्थे लामे वा धनगेऽपि वा : भूलाभश्चार्थलाभश्च पुत्रलाभसुखं भवेत ॥१४॥ गोमहिष्यादिलाभश्च शूद्रम्लाउ नं तथा ॥१४½॥

document: 15-15½. There will be gain of land, house, son and cattle, acquisition of riches and property through the enemy, etc., if Saturn be in kendra, trikona, the 11th or the 2nd from the lord of the Dasa (Jupiter).

metadata.sanskrit: दायेशाद्रिपुरन्ध्रस्थे व्यये वा पापसंयुते ॥१६॥ धनधान्यादिनाशस्च बन्धुमित्रविरोधकृत् । उद्योगभङ्गो देहातिः स्वजनानां महद्भयम् ॥१७॥

document: 16-17. Effects like loss of wealth, antagonistic relations with kinsmen, obstacles in industrial ventures, pains in the body, danger from the members of the family etc., will be realised if Saturn be in the 6th, the 8th or the 12th from the lord of the Dasa (Jupiter) or be associated with a malefic.

metadata.sanskrit: द्विसप्तमाधिपे मन्दे ह्यपमृत्युर्भविष्यति । तद्दोषपरिहारार्थं विष्णुसाहस्रकं जपेत् ॥१८॥ कृष्णां गां महिषीं दद्यादनेनारोग्यमादिशेत् । मन्दग्रहप्रसादेन सत्यं सत्यं द्विजोत्तम !॥१९॥

document:
18-19. There will be fear of premature death, if Saturn be lord of the 2nd or the 7th.
The remedial measures to obtain relief from these evil effects and to enjoy sound health, are recitation of Vision
Sahasranam and giving in charity a black cow or female buffalo.
Fflects of the Antardasa of Mercury in the Dasa of Jupiter.

metadata.sanskrit: जीवस्यान्तर्गते सौम्ये केन्द्रसाभविकोणगे। स्वोच्चे या स्वर्क्षगे वापि दशाधिपसमन्विते॥२०॥ अर्थलाभो देहसीख्यं राज्यलाभो महत्सुखम्। महाराजप्रसन्देन स्वेष्टसिद्धिः सुखायहा॥२१॥ बाहनाम्बरपश्वादिगोधनैस्संकुलं गृहम्॥२१॥॥

document: 20-21½. Effects like gains of wealth, bodily felicity, acquisition of a kingdom (attainment of a high position in government), fulfilment of ambitions by the beneficence of the king (government), gain of conveyances, clothes and cattle etc., will be derived in the Antardasa of Mercury in the Dasa of Jupiter, if Mercury be in his sign of exaltation, in his own sign or in kendra, trikona or be associated with the lord of the Dasa (Jupiter).

metadata.sanskrit: महीसुतेन संदृष्टे शत्नुवृद्धिः सुखक्षयः।।२२।। •यवसायात्फलं नेष्टं •थरातीसारपीडनम्।।२२३।।

document: 22-22½. There will be increase in the number of enemies, loss of enjoyment and comforts, loss in business, affliction with fever and dysentry, if Mercury be aspected by Mars.

metadata.sanskrit: बायेशाव्माग्यकोणे वा केन्द्रे वा तुङ्गराशिगे ॥२३॥ स्ववेशे धनलाभश्च पितृमातृसुखावहा । गजवाजिसमायुक्तो राजमित्रप्रसादतः ॥२४॥

document: 23-24. Gains of wealth in his own country, happiness from parents, acquisition of conveyances by the beneficence of the king (government), will result if Mercury be in kendra, the 5th or the 9th from the lord of the Dasa or be in his sign of exaltation.

metadata.sanskrit:
बायेशात्वष्ठरन्ध्रस्थे स्यये वा पापसंयुते। शुभदृष्टिविहीने च धनधान्यपरिच्युतिः॥२५॥
विदेशगमनं चैन भागें चौरभप्नं तथा। का वणवाहाक्षिरोगश्च नानादेशपरिश्रमः॥२६॥

document: 25-26. There will be loss of wealth, journeys to foreign countries, danger from thieves while travelling, wounds, burning sensations, eye troubles, wanderings in foreign lands, if Mercury be in the 6th, the 8th or the 12th from the lord of Dasa (Jupiter) or be associated with a malefic without the aspect of a benefic.

metadata.sanskrit:
लग्नात्वव्हाव्टमभावे वा व्यये वा पापसंयुते।
अकस्मात्कलहश्चेव गृहे निष्टुरभावणम् ॥२७॥
चतुष्पाङजीवहानिश्च व्यवहारे तथेव च।
अपमृत्युभयं चैव शत्रूणां कलहो भवेत्॥२८॥

document: 27-28. Distress without reason, anger, loss of cattle, loss in business, fear of premature death etc., will be the results if Mercury be associated with a malefic or malefies in the 6th, the 8th or the 12th from the Ascendant.

metadata.sanskrit: शुभदृष्टे शुभैर्युक्ते दारसीख्यं धनागमः। आदी शुभं देहसीख्यं बाहनाम्बरलामकृत्।।२६॥ अन्ते तु धनहानिश्चेत्स्वात्मसीख्यं न जायते।।२६½॥

document: 29-29½. There will be enjoyment, gains of wealth, conveyances and clothes at the commencement of the Antardasa, even if Mercury be associated with a malefic but aspected by a benefic. At the end of the Dasa, however, there will be loss of wealth and bodily distress.

metadata.sanskrit: द्वितीयद्युतनाथे वा ह्यपमृत्युर्भविष्यति ॥३०॥ तद्दोषपरिहारार्थं विष्णुसाहस्रकं जपेत् । आयुर्वे द्विकरं चैव सर्वसीभाग्यदायकम् ॥३१॥

document: 30-31. Premature death may be expected if Mercury be the lord of the 2nd or the 7th. The most effective and beneficial remedial measure for prolongation of longevity and to obtain relief from other evil effects is recitation of Vishnu Sahasranam.

metadata.sanskrit: Effects of the Antardasa of Ketu in the Dasa of Jupiter जीवस्थान्तर्गते केती शुभग्रहसमन्विते। अल्पसौढ्यधनावाप्तिः कुत्सितान्नस्य भोजनम् ॥३२॥ परान्नं चैव श्राद्धान्नं पापमृलाद्धनानि च ॥३२½॥

document: 32-32½. Moderate enjoyment, moderate gain of wealth, coarse food or food given by others, food given at the time of death ceremonies and acquisition of wealth through undesirable means, will be the remains, in the Antardasa of Ketu in the Dasa of Jupiter, if Ketu be associated with or aspected by benefic.

metadata.sanskrit: दायेशाद्रिपुरन्ध्रस्थे ध्यये वा पापसंयुते ॥३३॥ राजकोपो धनच्छेदो बन्धनं रोगपीडनम् । बलहानिः पितृहेषो भ्रातृहेषो मनोरुजः॥३४॥

document: 33-34. Effects like loss of wealth by the wrath of the king, imprisonment, diseases, loss of physical strength, antagonism with father and brother and mental agony, will be experienced if Ketu be in the 6th, the 8th or the 12th from the lord of the Dasa or be associated with malefics.

metadata.sanskrit: दायेशात्सुतमाग्यस्थे वाहने कर्मगेऽपि वा । नरवाहनयोगश्च गजाश्याम्बरसङ्कृलम् ॥३४॥ महाराजप्रसादेन स्वेष्टकार्यार्थलामकृत् । व्यवसायात्फलाधिक्यं गोमहिष्यादिलामकृत् ॥३६॥ यवनप्रमुमूलाद्वा धनवस्त्रादिलामकृत् ॥३६½॥

document: 35-36. Acquisition of a palanquin (motor car), elephants etc., beneficence of the king, success in the desired spheres, profits in business, increase in the number of cattle, gain of wealth, clothes etc. from a Yavana king (muslim dignitary), will be the auspicious effects if Ketu be in the 5th, the 9th, the 4th or the 10th from the lord of the Dasa (Jupiter).

The remedial measure to obtain relief from the above evil effects, is performance of Mrityunjaya Japa in the prescribed manner.
Effects of the Antardasa of Venus in the Dasa of Jupiter

metadata.sanskrit:
द्वितीयद्यूननाथे तु देहबादाः भविष्यति ॥३७॥ छागदानं प्रकुर्वीत मृत्युञ्जयजपं चरेत्। सर्वदोषोपशभनीं शान्ति कुर्याद्विधानतः॥३८॥ 37-38. There will be physical distress if Ketu be the lord of the 2nd or the 7th (or in the 2nd or the 7th).
जीवस्यान्तगंते शुक्रे माग्यकेन्द्रेशसंयुते।
लाभे वा सुतराशिस्थे स्वक्षेत्रे शुभसंयुते।।३६॥
नरवाहनयोगश्च गजाश्वाम्बरसंयुतः।
महाराजप्रसादेन लाभाधिक्यं महत्सुखम्॥
नीलाम्बराणां रक्तानां लाभश्चेय भविष्यति॥४०॥
पूर्वस्यां दिशि विप्रेन्त्र ! प्रयाणं धनलाभदम्।
कत्याणं च महाप्रीतिः पितृमातृसुखावहा॥४९॥
वेवतागुरुभक्तिश्च अन्तदानं महत्तथा।
लडागगोपुरादीनि विशेत् पुण्यानि मूरिशः॥४२॥
वष्ठाष्टमस्यये नीचे दायेशाद्वा तथैव च।
कलहो बन्धुवैषम्यं दारपुत्रादिपोडनम्॥४३॥

document: 39-43. Effects like acquisition of conveyances like palanquin, elephants etc., gain of wealth by the beneficence of the king, enjoyment, gain of blue and red articles, extraordinary income from journeys to the East, well being in the family, happiness from parents, devotion to deities, construction of reservoirs, charities etc., will be derived in the Antardasa of Venus if he be in kendra, trikona, the 11th from the Ascendant or be in his own sign, and be aspected by a benefic or benefics.

metadata.sanskrit: मन्दारराहुसंयुवतो कलहो राजतो मयम् । स्त्रीमूलात्कलहश्चेब श्वसुरात्कलहस्तथा ॥४४॥ सोदरेण विवादः स्याद्धनधान्यपरिच्युतिः ॥४४½॥

document:
44-44½. Evil effects like quarrels, antagonism with kinsmen, distress to wife and children, will be felt if Venus be in the 6th, the 8th or the 12th from the lord of the Dasa of Ascendant.
or be in his sign of debilitation. There will be quarrels, danger from the king, antagonism with the wife, disputes with the father-in-law and brothers, loss of wealth etc., if Venus be associated with Saturn or Rahu or with both.

metadata.sanskrit: दायेशात्केन्द्रराशिस्थे धने वा भाग्यगेऽपि वा ॥४५॥ धनधान्यादिलाभश्च श्रीलाभो राजदर्शनम् ॥४६॥ बाहनं पुत्रलाभश्च पशुवृद्धिर्महत्सुख्यम् । गीतवाद्यप्रसङ्गादिविद्वज्जनसमागमः ॥४७॥ दिव्यान्नभोजनं सौख्यं स्वबन्धुजनपोषकम् ॥४७½॥

document: 45-47½. There will be gain of wealth, happiness from wife, meeting with the king, increase in the number of children, conveyances and cattle, enjoyment of music, society with men of learning, availability of sweetish preparations, giving help and assistanca to kinsmen etc., if Venus be in kendra, trikona or the 2nd from the lord of the Dasa (Jupiter).

metadata.sanskrit: द्विसप्तमाधिये शुक्ते तद्दशायां धनक्षतिः ॥४८॥ अपमृत्युष्मयं तस्य स्त्रीमूलादीषधादितः । तस्य रोगस्य शान्त्यर्थं शान्तिकमं समाचरेत् ॥४९॥ श्वेतां गां महिबीं दद्यादायुरारोग्यवृद्धये । शुक्रप्रहप्रसादेन ततः सुखमवाप्नुयात् ॥४०॥

document:
48-50. Loss of wealth, fear of premature death, antagonism with wife etc., will be experienced if Venus be the lord of the 2nd or the 7th.
The remedial measure to obtain relief from the evil effects is giving a tauny coloured cow or female buffalo in charity.

metadata.sanskrit:
Effects of the Antardasa of the Sun in the Dasa of Jupiter जीवस्यान्तगंते सूर्ये स्वोच्चे स्वक्षेत्रगेऽपि वा। केन्द्रे वाऽधित्रकोचे च दुश्चिक्ये लामगेऽपि वा।।४१।। धने वा बलसंयुते वायेशाद्वा तथैव च। तत्काले धनलामः स्वाद्वाजसम्मानवैभवम्।।४२।।
बाहनाम्बरपश्वाविमूषणं पुत्रसम्मवः। मित्रप्रमुवशादिष्टं सर्वकार्ये शुभावहम्।।५३॥

document: 51-53. Gain of wealth, reverence, happiness and acquisition of conveyances, clothes, ornaments etc., birth of children, cordial relations with the king (government), success in ventures, etc., will be the auspicious results in the Antardasa of the Sun in the Dasa of Jupiter, if the Sun be in his sign of exaltation, in his own sign, in kendra, trikona, the 3rd, the 11th or the 2nd from the Ascendant and be endowed with strength.

metadata.sanskrit:
लग्नादष्टमध्यये सूर्ये दायेशाद्वा तथैव च।
शिरोरोगादिपीडा च ज्यरपीडा तथैव च।।५४॥
सत्कर्मसु तदा होनः पापकर्म-चयस्तथा।
सर्वत्र जनविद्वेषो ह्यात्मबन्ध्वियोगकृत्।।५५॥
अकस्मात्कलहश्चैव जीवस्यान्तर्गते रवौ।।५५॥

document: 54-55½. Effects like nervous disorder, fever, laziness or reluctance in the performance of good deeds, indulgence in sins, antagonistic attitude towards all, separation from kinsmen and distress without reasons, will be experienced, if the Sun be in the 6th, the 8th or the 12th from the Ascendant or the lord of the Dasa (Jupiter).

metadata.sanskrit: द्वितीयद्यूननाथे तु देहपीडा मविष्यति ॥५६॥ तद्दोषपरिहारार्थमादित्यहृदयं जपेत् । सर्वपीडोपशमनं श्रीसूर्यस्य प्रसादतः ॥५७॥

document:
56-57. There will be physical distress if the Sun be the lord of the 2nd or the 7th.
The remedial measure to obtain relief from the above evil effects and to enjoy good health is recitation of Aditya Hridaya Path (वादिस्य हृदय पाठ).

metadata.sanskrit: Effects of the Antardasa of the Moon in the Dasa of Jupiter जीवस्यान्तर्गते चन्द्रे केन्द्रे लाभितकोणगे। स्वोच्चे वा स्वर्क्षराशिस्थे पूर्णे चैव बलैर्युते॥५८॥ बायेशाच्छुभराशिस्थे राजसम्मानवैभवम् । बारपुर्वादिसौख्यं च क्षीराणां मोजनं तथा। १५६॥ सत्कर्मं च तथा कोतिः पुत्रपौद्धादिवृद्धिदा। महाराजाप्रसादेन सर्वसौद्ध्यं धनागनः ॥६०॥ अनेकजनसौद्ध्यं च दानधमदिसंग्रहः ॥६०३॥

document: 58-60½. Effects like reverence from the king (government), opulence and glory, happiness from wife and children, availability of good food, gain of reputation by performance of good deeds, increase in the number of children and grand children, all comforts by the beneficence of the king (government), religious and charitable inclinations, etc., will be derived in the Antardasa of the Moon in the Dasa of Jupiter, if the Moon be in kendra, trikona or the 11th from the Ascendant, be in her sign of exaltation or in her own sign and be full and strong and in an auspicious house from the lord of the Dasa (Jupiter).

metadata.sanskrit: र्मात्वाष्ट्राष्ट्रमध्यये चन्द्रे स्थिते वा पापसंयुते ॥६१॥ व्यापेशात्ष्र्वठरन्द्रे वा व्यये वा बलवर्जिते । व्यापेशात्ष्र्यकृत्यात्रम् विदेशपरिविच्युतिः ॥६२॥ तृपचौरादिपोडा च दायादजनविप्रहः । मातुलादिवियोगश्च मातुपीडा तथैव च ॥६३॥

document: 61-63. There will be loss of wealth and kinsmen, wanderings in foreign lands, danger from the king (government) and thieves, quarrels with co-parceners, separation from maternal uncle, distress to mother etc., if the Moon be weak or associated with malefics or be in the 6th, the 8th or the 12th from the Ascendant or the lord of the Dasa (Jupiter).

भोजनाम्बरसौद्ध्यं च ह्यादौ मध्ये सुखावहम्।।८।।।

document: 6-8½. Effects like physical fitness, the gain of wealth, affectionate relations with kinsmen increase in cattle wealth, income from industries, success in educational sphere, acquisition of name and fame, honours, audience with the king and joining in a banquet with him, comforts of clothes etc., will be experienced, if Ketu be associated with benefics in kendra or trikona from the Ascendant or be in conjunction with the lord of the Ascendant or a yogakaraka. The same will be the results if Ketu be in kendra or the 11th from the lord of the Dasa (Mercury).

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit: दायेशाद्यदि रन्ध्रस्थे व्यये वा पापसंयुते ॥६॥ वाहनात्पतनं चैव पुत्रवलेशादिसम्भवः । चौरादिराजभीतिश्च पापकर्मरतः सदा ॥१०॥ वृश्चिकादिविषाद्भीतिर्नोचैः कलहसंभवः । शोकरोगादिदुःखं च नीचसङ्गादिकं भवेत् ॥११॥

document:
9-11. Fall from a conveyance, distress to son, danger from the king, indulgence in sinful deeds, danger from scorpions etc., quarrels with the menials, sorrow, diseases and association with meanials etc., wilkbe the results, if Ketu be in association
with malefics in the 8th or the 12th from the lord of the Dasa (Mercury).

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit: द्वितीयद्यूननाथे तु देहजाडचं भविष्यति । तद्दोषपरिहाराय छागदानं तु कारयेत् ॥१२॥

document:
12. There will be physical distress if Ketu be the lord of the 2nd or the 7th (from the Ascendant).
The remedial measure to obtain relief from the above evil effects, is giving a goat in charity.
Effects of the Antardasa of Venus in the Dasa of Mercury

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury

document: 13-15\frac{1}{2}. Effects like inclination to perform religious rites, fulfilment of all ambitions through the help of the king (government) and friends, gains of agricultural lands and happiness etc., will be derived in the Antardasa of Venus in the Dasa of Mercury, if Venus be in kendra, the 11th, the 5th or the 9th from the Ascendant. There will be acquisition of a kingdom (attainment of a high position in government), gain of wealth and property, construction of a reservoir, readiness to give charities and performance of religious rites, extraordinary gains of wealth and gains in business, if Venus be in kendra, the 5th, the 9th or the 11th from the lord of the Dasa (Mercury).

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit:
सौम्यस्यान्तर्गते शुक्रे केन्द्रे लाभे विकोणमे।
सत्कथापुण्यधर्मादिसंग्रहः पुण्यकर्मकृत् ॥१३॥
मित्रप्रभुवशादिष्टं क्षेत्रलाभः सुखं भवेत्।
दशाधिपात्केन्द्रगते विकोणे लाभगेऽपि वा॥१४॥
तत्काले श्रियमाप्नोति राजश्रीधनसम्पदः।
वापीकृपतडागादिदानधर्मादिसंग्रहः ॥१४॥
व्यवसायात्फलाधिक्यं धनधान्यसमृद्धिकृत्॥१४%॥
दायेशात्वष्ठरन्ध्रस्थे ध्यये वा बलवर्जिते ॥१६॥ हृद्रोगो मानहानिश्च ज्वरातीसारपीडनम् । आत्मबन्ध्वियोगश्च संसारे भवति ध्रुवम् ॥१७॥ आत्मकष्टं सनस्तापदायकं द्विजसत्तम !॥१७॥॥ 16-17½. Heart disease, defamation, fevers, dysentry, separation from kinsmen, physical distress and agony will result if Venus be weak in the 6th, the 8th or the 12th from the lord or the Dasa.
द्वितीयद्यूननाथे तु ह्यपमृत्युर्भविष्यति ॥९८॥ तद्दोषपरिहारार्थं दुर्गादेवीजपं चरेत्। जगदम्बाप्रसादेन ततः शान्तिमवाप्नुयात् ॥९६॥

document:
18-19. There will be fear of premature death if Venus be the lord of the 2nd or the 7th (from the Ascendant).
The remedial measure to obtain relief from the above evil effects is to recite mantras of Goddess Durga.
Effects of the Antardasa of the Sun in the Dasa of Mercury

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit:
सौम्यस्थान्तर्गते सूर्ये स्वोच्चे त्त्रक्षेत्रकेन्द्रगे।
तिकोणे धनलामे तु तृज्यास्यांशगेऽपि वा।।२०॥
राजप्रसादसोनान्यं मित्रप्रवशात्मुखम्।
भूम्यात्मजेन संदृष्टे आदौ भूलाभमादिशेत्।।२९॥
लग्नाधिपेन संदृष्टे बहुसौख्यं धनागमम्।
ग्रामभूम्यादिलाभं च भोजनाम्बरसौख्यकृत्।।२२॥

document: 20-22. Effects like dawn of fortune by the beneficence of the king (high government officials), happiness from friends etc., will be derived in the Antardasa of the Sun in the Dasa of Mercury, if the Sun is in his own sign or sign of exaltation or in kendra, trikona, the 2nd or the 11th, in exalted or own Navamsa. There will be acquisition of land if the Sun is aspected by Mars and comforts of good food and clothes if such a Sun be aspected by the lord of the Ascendant.

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury

document:
23-24. Fear or danger from thieve!' fire and weepons, bilio-is troubles, headaches, mental agony and separation from friends ctc., will be the results if the sun be in the 6th'-the 8tb or the 12th from the Ascenclant or thc lord of the Dasa (Mcrcury), be weak and be associated with Saturn, Mars and Rahu.

26-27. The yoga becomes very strong for beneficial' effects if in the Antardasa of the Moon in the Dasa of Mercury" the Moon be in kendra or trikona from the Ascendant or be in her sign of exaltation or in her own sign associated with or aspected by Jupiter or be a yogakaraka herself. 28-29t. In the . circumstances nentioned above, therc also be ,:onstruction of a new house, availability of sweetish preparation, enjoyment of music, study of Shastras, journey to the South, gains of clothes from beyond the seas, gain of gems like pearls etc.

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit: ेनीचारिक्षेत्रसंयुक्ते देहबाधा भविष्यति ।।३०।। दायेशात्केन्द्रकोणस्थे दुश्चिक्ये लाभगेऽपि वा । तद्भुक्त्यादौ पुण्यतीर्थस्थानदैवतदर्शनम् ।।३९।। मनोधैर्यं हुदुत्साहो विदेशधनलाभकृत् ।।३९∄।।

document: 30-31½. There will be physical distress if the Moon be in her sign of debilitation or in an enemy's sign. If the Moon be in kendra, trikona, the 3rd or the 11th from the lord of the Dasa (Mercury), there will be at the commencement of the Antardasa visits to sacred shrines, patience, enthusiasm and gains of wealth from foreign countries.

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit: दायेशात्वष्ठरन्ध्रे वा ब्यये वा पापसंयुते ॥३२॥ चोराग्निनृपभीतिश्च स्त्रीसमागमतो भवेत् । दुष्कृतिर्धनहानिश्च कृषिगोश्वादिनाशकृत् ॥३३॥

document: 32-33. Danger from the king, fire and thieves, defamation or disgrace and loss of wealth on account of wife, destruction of agricultural lands and cattle etc., will be the results if the Moon be weak, and be in the 6th, the 8th or the 12th from the lord of the Dasa (Mercury).

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit: द्वितीयद्यननाथे तु देहबाघा भविष्यति । तद्दोषपरिहारार्थं दुर्गादेवीजपं चरेत् ॥३४॥ वस्त्रदानं प्रकुर्वीत आयुर्वृद्धिसुखावहम् । जगदम्बाप्रसादेन ततः सुखमवाप्नुयात् ॥३५॥

document:
34-35. There will be physical distress if the Moon be the lord of the 2nd or the 7th (from the Ascendant).
There will be relief, prolongation of longevity and restoration of comforts by the beneficence of Goddess Durga if the mantras of the Goddess are recited in the prescribed manner and clothes are given in charity.
Effects of the Antardasa of Mars in the Dasa of Mercury

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit:
सोम्यस्यान्तर्गते भौमे लग्नात्केन्द्रविकोणगे।
स्वोच्चे वा स्वक्षंगे वापि लग्नाधिपसमन्विते।।३६॥
राजानुग्रहशान्ति च गृहे कल्याणसम्भवम्।
लक्ष्मीकटाक्षचिह्नानि नष्टराज्यार्थमाप्नुयात्।।३७॥
पुत्नोत्सवादिसन्तोषं गृहं गोधनसंकुलम्।
गृहक्षेत्राविलाभं च गजवाजिसमन्दितम्॥३८॥
राजप्रीतिकरं चैव स्त्रीसौक्ष्यं चातिशोभनम्॥३८%।

document: 36-38½. Effects like well being and enjoyments in the family by the beneficence of the king (government), increase in property, recovery of lost kingdom etc., (reinstatement in a high position in government), birth of son, satisfaction, acquisition of cattle, coneyances and agricultural lands, happiness from wife etc., will be derived in the Antardasa of Mars in the Dasa of Mercury, if Mars be in his sign of exaltation, in his own sign, in kendra or trikona from the Ascendant or be associated with the lord of the Ascendant.

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit: नीचक्षेत्रसमायुक्ते ह्यष्टमे वा व्ययेऽपि वा ॥३६॥ पापदृष्टियुते वापि देहपीडा मनोव्यथा। उद्योगभङ्गो देशादौ स्वग्रामे धान्यनाशनम् ॥४०॥ ग्रंथिशस्त्रवणादीनां भयं तापज्वरादिकम् ॥४०॥॥

document: 39-40½. Physical distress, mental agony, obstacles in industrial ventures, loss of wealth, gout, distress from wounds, and danger from weapons and fever etc., will be the results if Mars be associated with or aspected by malefics in the 800 % the 12th from the Ascendant.

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit: दायेशात्केन्द्रगे भौमे विकोणे लामगेऽपि वा ॥४१॥ शुभवृष्टे धनप्राप्तिदेंहसौष्यं भवेन्नृणाम् । पुत्रलाभो यशोवृद्धिर्भातृवर्गो महाप्रियः ॥४२॥

document:
41-42. There will be gain of wealth, physical felicity, birth of a son, good reputation, affectionate relations etc., with
kinsmen etc., if Mars be aspected by benefics in kendra, trikona or the 11th from the lord of the Dasa (Mercury).

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit: बायेशावथ रन्ध्रस्थे व्यये वा पापसंयुते। तव्भुक्त्यादौ महावलेशो भ्रातृयगे महब्भयम्।।४३॥ नृपाग्निचौरभीतिश्व पुत्रमित्रविदोधनम्। स्थानभ्रंशो भवेदादौ मध्ये सौख्यं धनागमः॥४४॥ अन्ते तु राजभीतिः स्यात्स्थानभ्रंशोह्यथापिवा॥४४ है॥

document:
43-44½. If Mars be associated with malefics in the 8th or the 12th from the lord of the Dasa (Mercury), there will be—
- (1) Distress, danger from kinsmen, whath of the king and fire, antagonism with the son, loss of position, at the commencement of the Antardasa.
- (2) Enjoyments and gains of wealth in the middle portion of the Antardasa.
- (3) Danger from the king (government) and loss of position at the end of the Antardasa.

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit: द्वितीयद्यननाथे तु ह्यपमृत्युभयं भवेत्।।४४।। गोदानं च प्रकुर्वीत मृत्युञ्जयजपं चरेत्। शङ्करस्य प्रसादेन ततः सुखमवाप्नुयात्।।४६॥

document:
45-46. There will be fear of premature death if Mars be the lord of the 2nd or the 7th from the Ascendant.
The remedial measures to be adopted to obtain relief from the above evil effects are Mrityunjaya Japa and giving a cow in charity.
Effects of the Antardasa of Rahu in the Dasa of Mercury

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit:
बुधस्यान्तर्गते राहाँ केन्द्रलाभितकोणगे।
कुलीरे कुम्भगे वापि कन्यायां वृत्रभेषि वा।।४७॥
राजसम्मानकीर्ती च धनं च प्रभविष्यति।
पृण्यतीर्थस्थानलाभो देवतावर्शनं तथा॥४८॥
इष्टापूर्ते च महतो मानश्चाम्बरलाभकृत्।
भुक्त्यावौ देहपीडा च त्वन्ते सौड्यं विनिविशेत्॥४६॥

document: 47-49. Effects like reverence from the king (government), good reputation, gain of wealth, visits to sacred shrines, performance of religious sacrifices and oblations, recognition, gain of clothes etc., are derived in the Antardasa of Rahu in the Dasa of Mercury if Rahu be in kendra or trikona from the Ascendant or be in Aries, Aquarius, Virgo, or Taurus. There will be some evil effects at the commencement of the Antardasa but all will be well later.

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit: लग्नाष्टस्ययगान्तिस्थे तद्भुक्तौ धननाशनम् । मुक्त्यादौ केह्नाशश्च वातज्वरमजीर्णकृत् ॥५०॥

document: 50. Loss of wealth, rheumatic fever, and indigestion will be the results if Rahu be in the 8th or the 12th from the Ascendant.

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit: ाग्नादुपचये राहौ शुभग्रहसमन्विते। राजसंलापसन्तोषो नूतनप्रभुदर्शनम् ॥४१॥

document: 51. There will be an opportunity to have conversation or a meeting with the king (high dignitaries), if Rahu be in the 3rd, the 8th, the 10th or the 11th from the Ascendant. In this position if Rahu be associated with a benefic, there will be a visit to a new king (dignitary).

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit: बायेशाव्द्वावशे वापि ह्याच्टमे पापसंयुते। निष्ठुरं राजकार्याणि स्थानभ्रंशो महद्भयम्॥५२॥ बन्धनं रोगपीडा च निज-बन्धुमनोब्यथा। हृद्रोगो मानहानिश्व धनहानिर्मविष्यति॥५३॥

document: 52-53. Pressure of hard work as a government functionary, loss of position, fears, imprisonment, diseases, agony to self and kinsmen, heart disease, loss of reputation and wealth, will be the results if Rahu be associated with a malefic or malefics in the 8th or the 12th from the lord of the Dasa (Mercury).

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit:
द्वितीयसप्तमस्थे दा हापमृत्युर्भविष्यति । तद्दोषपद्भिहारार्थं दुर्गालक्ष्मीजपं चरेत् ॥५४॥
श्वेतां गां महिषीं बद्यादायुरारोग्यदायिनीम्। जगदम्बात्रसादेन ततः सुखमवाप्नुयात्।।४४॥

document:
54-55. There will be fear of premature death if Rahu be in the 2nd or the 6th from the Ascendant.
The remedial measures to obtain relief from the above evil effects, are recitation of mantras of Goddess Durga and Goddess Lakshmi in the prescribed manner and giving a tawny coloured cow or female buffalo in charity.
Effects of the Antardasa of Jupiter in the Dasa of Mercury

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit:
बुधस्यान्तर्गते जीवे लग्नात्केन्द्रतिकोणगे।
स्थोच्चे वा स्वक्षंगे वापि लाभे वा धनराशिगे।।४६॥
देहसीस्यं धनावाप्ती राजप्रीतिस्तर्थंव च।
विवाहोत्सवकार्याणि नित्यं मिष्ठान्नभोजनम्।।४७॥
गोमहिष्याविलाभका पुराणश्रवणाविकम्।
देवतागृरुभिवतश्च वानधर्ममखाविकम्।।४८॥
यज्ञकर्मप्रवृद्धिश्च शिवपूजाफलं तथा।।४८%॥

document: 56-58½. Effects like physical felicity, gain of wealth, beneficence of the king, celebration of auspicious functions like marriage etc., at home, availability of sweetish preparations, increase in cattle wealth, attending discourses on Puranas (religious scriptures) etc., devotion to deities and the preceptor, interest in religion, charities etc., worship of Lord Shiva etc., will be derived in the Antardasa of Jupiter in the Dasa of Mercury, if Jupiter be in kendra, trikona or the 11th from the Ascendant or be in his sign of exaltation or in his own sign.

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit: नोचे वास्तंगते वापि षष्ठाष्टव्ययगेऽपि वा ॥५६॥ शन्यारदृष्टसंयुक्ते कलहो राजविग्रहः। चौरादिदेहपीडा च पितृमातृविनाशनम्॥६०॥ मानहानी राजवण्डो धनहानिर्भविष्यति। विषाहिज्वरपोडा च कृषिभूमिविनाशनम्॥६१॥

document:
59-61. Discord with kings and kinsmen, danger from thieves etc., death of parents, disgrace, punishment from
government, loss of wealth, danger from snakes and poison, fever, losses in agricultural production, loss of lands etc., will be the results, if Jupiter be in his sign of debilitation, be combust, or be in the 6th, the 8th or the 12th from the Ascendant or be associated with or aspected by Saturn and Mars.

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit: वायेशात्केन्द्रकोणे वा लाभे वा बलसंयुते। बन्धुपुत्रहृदुत्साहो शुमं च घनसंयुतम्।।६२॥ पशुवृद्धियंशोवृद्धिरन्नवानादिकं फलम्। वायेशात्वष्ठरन्ध्रे वा व्यये वा बलवर्जिते।।६३॥ अङ्गतापश्च वैकल्यं देहबाधा भविष्यति।।६३३॥

document: 62-63½. There will be happiness from kinsmen and son, enthusiasm, increase in wealth and name and fame, giving grains etc., in charity, if Jupiter be in kendra, trikona or the 11th from the lord of the Dasa (Mercury) and be endowed with strength.

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit: कलव्रबन्धुवैषम्यं राजकोपो धनक्षयः ॥६४॥ अकस्मात्कलहाव्भीतिः प्रमादो द्विजतो भयम् ॥६४३॥

document: 64-64½. Agony, anxiety, danger from diseases, antagonism with wife and kinsmen, wrath of the king (government), quarrels, loss of wealth, danger from Brahmins (wrath of Brahmins), will be the results if Jupiter be weak and be in the 6th, the 8th or the 12th from the lord of the Dasa (Mercury).

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit: द्वितीयसप्तमस्थे वा देंहबाद्या भविष्यति ॥६४॥ तद्दोषपरिहारार्थे शिवसाहस्रकं जपेत् । गोभूहिरण्यदानेन सर्वारिष्टं व्यपोहति ॥६६॥

document:
65-66. There will be physical distress if Jupiter be the lord of the 2nd or the 7th or be in the 2nd or the 7th.
The remedial measures to obtain relief from the above evil effects are recitation of Shiva Sahasranama and giving a cow and gold in charity.
Effects of the Antardasa of Saturn in the Dasa of Mercury

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit:
सौम्यस्यान्तर्गते मन्त्रे स्वोच्चे स्वक्षेत्रकेन्द्रगे।
त्रिकोणलाभगे वापि गृहे कल्याणवर्द्धनम्।।६७॥
राज्यलाभं महोत्साहं गृहं गोधनसंकुलम्।।६८॥
शुभस्थानफलावाप्ति तीर्थवासं तथादिशत।।६८॥

document: 67-68½. Effects like well being in the family, acquisition of a kingdom (attainment of a high position in government), enthusiasm, increase in cattle wealth, gain of position, visits to sacred shrines etc., will be derived in the Antardasa of Saturn in the Dasa of Mercury, if Saturn be in his sign of exaltation, in his own sign, or in kendra, trikona or the 11th from the Ascendant.

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit: अष्टमे वा व्यये मन्दे दायेशाद्वा तथैव च ॥६६॥ अरातिदुःखबाहुल्यं दारपुतादिपीडनम् । बुद्धिश्रशो बन्धुनाशः कर्मनाशो मनोरुजः ॥७०॥ विदेशगमनं चैव दुःस्वप्नादिप्रदर्शनम् ॥७० ½॥

document: 69-70½. Danger from enemies, distress to wife and children, loss of thinking power, loss of kinsmen, loss in ventures, mental agony, journeys to foreign lands, bad dreams, will be the results, if Saturn be in the 8th or the 12th from the lord of the Dasa (Mercury).

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury
metadata.sanskrit: द्वितीयद्यूननाथे तु ह्यपमृत्युर्भविष्यति ॥७१॥ तद्दोषपरिहाराथं मृत्युञ्जयजपं चरेत्। कृष्णां गां महिषीं दद्यादायुरारोग्यवृद्धये॥७२॥

document:
71-72. There will be fear of premature death if Saturn be the lord of the 2nd or the 7th from the Ascendant.
The remedial measures to obtain relief from the above evil effects and to regain sound health, are performanc of Mrityunjaya Japa and giving a black cow and female buffalo in charity.

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Mercury

document:
Chapter 59
Effects of the Antardasas in the Dasa of Ketu
ects of the Antardasa of Ketu in the Dasa of Ketu

metadata.sanskrit:
अथ केत्वन्तर्दशाफलाध्यायः ॥५६॥
केन्द्रे तिकोणलाभे वा केतौ लग्नेशसंयुते। भाग्यकर्मसुसम्बन्धे वाहनेशसमन्विते॥१॥ तद्भुक्तौ धनधान्यादि चतुष्पाज्जीवलाभक्कत्। पुत्रदारादिसौढ्यं च राजप्रीतिमनोरुजः॥२॥ ग्रामभूम्यादिलाभश्च गृहं गोधनसंकुलम्॥२½॥

document: 1-2½. Effects like happiness from wife and children, cognition from the king (government) but mental agony, gain land, village etc., will be derived in the Antardasa of Ketu in own Dasa, if Ketu be in kendra or trikona from the Ascent or be associated with the lord of the Ascendant, or be ated to lords of the 9th, the 10th or the +th.

metadata.sanskrit: नीचास्तखेटसंयुक्ते ह्यब्दमे व्ययगेऽपि था ॥३॥ हृद्रोगो मानहानिश्च धनधान्यपशुक्षयः । दारपुत्रादिपीडा च मनश्चांचल्यमेथ च ॥४॥

document: 3-4. Heart disease, defamation, destruction of wealth and the, distress to wife and children, instability of mind etc., will the results, if Ketu be in his sign of debilitation and be in 8th or the 12th from the Ascendant alongwith a combust net.

5.6. There will be danger from diseases, great distress and separation from kinsmen, if Ketu be related to the lords of the 2nd or the 7th or be in the 2nd or the 7th from the Ascendant.
The remedial measures to obtain relief from the above evil effects are performance of Durga Saptashati Japa and Mrityunjaya Japa.
Effects of the Antardasa of Venus in the Dasa of Ketu

metadata.sanskrit:
द्वितीयद्यूननाथेन सम्बन्धे तत्र संस्थिते । अनारोग्यं महत्कष्टमात्मबन्धुबियोगकृत् ॥४॥ दुगदिवीजपं कुर्यानमृत्युञ्जयजपं चरेत्। एवं स्वान्तगंते केतौ ततः सुखमवाप्नुयात्॥६॥
केतोरन्तर्गते शुक्ते स्वीच्चे स्वक्षेत्रसंयुते। केन्द्रविकोणलाभे वा राज्यनाथेन संयुते॥७॥ राजप्रीति च सौभाग्यं दिशेत्स्वाम्बरसंकुलम्। तत्काले श्रियमाप्नोति भाग्यकर्मेशसंयुते॥६॥ नष्टराज्यधनप्राप्ति सुखवाहनमृत्तमम्। सेतुस्मानादिकं चैव देवतादर्शनं महत्॥६॥ महाराजप्रसादेन - ग्रामभूम्यादिलामकृत्॥६½॥

document: 7-9½. Effects like beneficence from the king, good fortune, gain of clothes etc., recovery of lost kingdom (reinstatement in a high position in government), comforts of conveyances etc., visits to sacred shrines, gain of lands and villages by the beneficence of the king (government) will be derived in the Antardasa of Venus in the Dasa of Ketu, if Venus be in his sign of exaltation, in his own sign or be associated with the lord of the 10th in a kendra or trikona and there will be dawn of fortune if in such position he is associated with the lord of the 9th also.

metadata.sanskrit: द्वायेशात्केन्द्रकोणे वा बुश्चिक्ये लाभगेऽपि वा ॥१०॥ देहारोग्यं शुभं चैव गृहे कत्याणशोभनम्। भोजनाम्बरभूषाप्तिरथदोलादिलामकृत् ॥११॥

document:
10-11. Sound health, well being in the family, gains of good food and conveyances etc., will be the results, if Venus
be in kendra, trikona, the 3rd or the 11th from the lord of the Dasa (Ketu).

metadata.sanskrit:
वायेशाद्रिपुरन्द्रस्थे व्यये वा पापसंयुते।
अकस्मात्कलहं चैव पशुधान्यादिपी इनम् ॥१२॥
नीचस्थे खेटसंयुक्ते लग्नात्वच्छाब्दराशिये।
स्वबन्धुजनवैषम्यं शिरोक्षिज्ञजपी उनम् ॥१३॥
हृद्रोगं मानहानि च धनधान्यपशुक्षयम्।
कलव्रपुत्रपीडायाः सञ्चारं च समादिशेत्॥१४॥

document: 12-14. There will be quarrels without any cause, loss of wealth, distress to cattle if Venus be in the 6th, the 8th or the 12th from the lord of the Dasa (Ketu). If Venus be in his sign of debilitation or be associated with a debilitated planet, or be in the 6th or the 8th from the Ascendant, there will be quarrels with kinsmen, headache, eye troubies, heart disease, defamation, loss of wealth and distress to cattle and wife.

metadata.sanskrit: द्वितीयद्यूननाथे तु देहजाडघं मनोरुजम् । तद्दोषपरिहारार्थं द्रुगदिवीजपं चरेत् । श्वेतां गां महिषीं दद्यादायुरारोग्यवृद्धये ॥१५॥

document:
15. Physical distress and mental agony will be caused if Venus be the lord of the 2nd or the 7th.
The remedial measures to obtain relief from the abc evil effects, are performance of Durga Patha and giving a taw coloured cow or female buffalo in charity.
Effects of the Antardasa of the Sun in the Dasa of Ketu

metadata.sanskrit: केतो रन्तर्गते सूर्ये स्वीच्चे स्वक्षेत्रगेऽपि वा। केन्द्रत्निकोणलाभे वा शुभयुक्तनिरीक्षिते॥१६॥ धनधान्यादिलाभश्च राजानुग्रहवैभवम्। अनेकशुभकार्याणि चेष्टसिद्धिः सुखावहा॥१७॥

document:
16-17. The effects like gains of wealth, beneficence of the king, performance of pious deeds and fulfilment of all ambitions, will be derived in the Antardasa of the Sun in the Dasa of
Ketu. If the Sun be in his sign of exaltation, in his own sign or be associated or aspected by a benefice in kendra, trikona or the 11th.

metadata.sanskrit: अष्टमध्ययराशिस्थे पापग्रहसमन्विते । तद्भुक्तौ राजभीतिश्च पितृमातृवियोगकृत् ॥१८॥ विदेशगमनं चैव चौराहिविषपीडनम् । राजिमत्रविरोधश्च राजदण्डाद्धनक्षयः ॥१६॥ शोकरोगभयं चैव उष्णाधिक्यं ज्वरोभवेत् ॥१६½॥

document: 18-19½. Danger from the king (government), separation from parents, journeys to foreign lands, destress from thieves, snakes and poison, punishment by government, antagonism with the friends, sorrows, danger from fever etc., will be the results if the Sun be associated with a malefic or malefics, in the 8th or the 12th from the Ascendant.

metadata.sanskrit: वायेशात्केन्द्रकोणे वा लाभे वा धनसंस्थिते ॥२०॥ देहसौढ्यं चार्थलाभो पुत्रलाभो मनोदृढम् ॥ सर्वकार्यार्थसिद्धिः स्यात्स्वल्पग्रामाधिपत्ययुक् ॥२१॥

document: 20-21. There will be physical fitness, gain of wealth, birth of a son, success in performance of pious deeds, headship of a small village etc., if the Sun be in kendra, trikona, the 2nd or the 11th from the lord of the Dasa (Kctu).

metadata.sanskrit: दायेशाद्रन्ध्निरःफे वा स्थिते वा पापसंयुते। अन्नविष्टनो मनोभीतिर्धनधान्यपशुक्षयः॥२२॥ आदौ मध्ये महावलेशानन्ते सौख्यं विनिर्दिशेत्। द्वितीयसप्तमाधीशे हृप्यमृत्युर्भविष्यति॥२३॥ तस्य शान्ति प्रकुर्वीत स्वर्णं धेनुं प्रदापयेत्। भास्करस्य प्रसादेन ततः सुखमवाप्नुयात्॥२४॥

document:
22-24. Obstacles in availability of food, fears, loss of vealth and cattle, will be the results if the Sun be associated with evil planets in the 8th or the 12th from the lord of the Dasa (Ketu). There will be distress at the commencement of
the Antardasa with some mitigation of its end. There will be fear of premature death if the Sun be the lord of the 2nd or the 7th.
The remedial measure to obtain relief from the above evil effects and to regain comforts by the beneficence of the Sun, is to give a cow and gold in charity.
Effects of the Antardasa of the Moon in the Dasa of Ketu

metadata.sanskrit:
केतोरन्तर्गते चन्द्रे स्वोच्चे स्वक्षेत्रगेऽपि वा।
केन्द्रितकोणलाभे वा धने शुभसमन्विते॥२५॥
राजप्रीतिर्महोत्साहः कत्याणं च महत्सुखम्।
महाराजप्रसादेन गृहभूम्यादिलाभकृत्॥२६॥
भोजनाम्बरपश्वादिव्यवसायेऽधिकं फलम्।
अश्ववाहनलाभश्च वस्त्राभरणभूषणम्॥२७॥
देवालयतडागादिपुण्यधर्मादिसङ्ग्रहम् ।
पुत्रदारादिसौख्यं च पूर्णचन्द्रः प्रयच्छित ॥२८॥

document: 25-28. Effects like recognition from the king (government), enthusiasm, well being, enjoyments, acquisition of a house, lands etc., abnormal gains of food, clothes, conveyances, cattle etc., sucess in business, construction of reservoirs etc., and happiness to wife and children will be derived in the Antardasa of the Moon in the Dasa of Ketu, if the Moon be in her sign of exaltation, in her own sign, in kendra, trikona, the 11th or the 2nd from the Ascendant. The beneficial results will be realised fully if the Moon be waxing.

metadata.sanskrit: क्षीणे वा नीचगे चन्द्रे षष्ठाष्ट्रव्ययराशिगे। आत्मसौख्यं मनस्तापं कार्यविष्टनं महव्भयम्॥२६॥ पितृमातृवियोगं च देहजाडचं मनोव्यथाम्। व्यवसायात्फलं कष्टं पशुनाशं भयं वदेत्॥३०॥

document:
29-30. Unhappiness and mental agony, obstacles in ventures, separation from parents, losses in business, destruction of cattle etc., will be caused if the Moon be in her sign of
debilitation or be in the 6th, the 8th or the 12th from the Ascendant.

metadata.sanskrit:
वायेशात्केन्द्रकोणे वा लाभे वा बलसंयुते।
कृषिगोभूमिलाभं च इष्टबन्धुसमागमम् ॥३१॥
तस्मात्स्वकार्यसिद्धि च गृहे गोक्षीरमेव च।
मुक्त्यादौ शुममारोग्यं मध्ये राजित्रयं शुमम् ॥३२॥
अन्ते तु राजभीति च विदेशगमनं तथा।
दूरयावादिसञ्चारं सम्बन्धिजनपूजनम् ॥३३॥

document: 31-33. There will be acquisition of a cow or cows, land, agricultural lands, meeting kinsmen and achievement of success through them, increase in cow's milk and curd, if the Moon be in kendra, trikona or the 11th from the lord of the Dasa (Ketu) and be endowed with strength. There will be auspicious results at the commencement of the Antardasa; cordial relations with the king (government) in its middle portion and danger from the king (government) foreign journey or journeys to distant places at its end.

metadata.sanskrit: वायेशात्वष्ठिरः के वा रन्ध्रं वा बलर्वाजते ! धनधान्याविहानिश्च मनोन्याकुलमेव च ॥३४॥ स्वबन्धुजनवैरं च भ्रातृपोडा तथैव च ॥ निधनाधिपदोषेण द्विसप्तपतिसंयुते ॥३४॥ अपमृत्युभयं तस्य शान्ति कुर्याद्यथाविधि ॥ चन्द्रशीतिकरीं चैव स्थायुरारोग्यसिद्धये ॥३६॥

document:
34-36. Loss of wealth, anxiety, enmity with kinsmen and distress to brother, will be the results, if the Moon be in the 6th, the 8th or the 12th from the lord of the Dasa (Ketu). If Moon be the lord of the 2nd, the 7th or the 8th, there will be fear of premature death.
The remedial measures to obtain relief from the above effects are recitation of mantras of the Moon and giving in charity things connected with the Moon (See effects af Antardasas of the Moon in the Dasa of other planets).
Effects of the Antardasa of Mars in the Dasa of Ketu

metadata.sanskrit:
केतोरन्तर्गते भौमे लग्नात्केन्द्रतिकोणगे।
स्वोच्चे स्वक्षेत्रगे बाऽिष शुभग्रहयुतेक्षिते।।३७॥
आदौ शुभकलं चैव ग्रामभूम्यादिलाभकृत्।
धनधान्यादिलाभश्च चतुष्पाज्जीवलाभकृत्।।३८॥
गृहारामक्षेत्रलाभो राजानुग्रहवैभवम्।
भाग्ये कर्मेशसम्बन्धे भूलाभः सौष्ट्यमेव च।।३६॥

document: 37-39. Effects like acquisition of land, village etc., increase in wealth and cattle, laying out of a new garden, gain of wealth by the beneficence of the king, will be derived in the Antardasa of Mars in the Dasa of Ketu, if Mars be in his sign of exaltation in his own sign associated with or aspected by the benefics. If Mars be related to the lords of the 9th or the 10th, there will definitely be gain of land and enjoyment.

metadata.sanskrit: दायेशात्केन्द्रकोणे वा दुश्चिक्ये लाभगेऽपि वा। राजप्रीतियशोलाभः पुत्रसिदादिसौख्यकृत्।।४०।।

document: 40. There will be recognition from the king, great popularity and reputation and happiness from children and friends, if Mars be in kendra, trikona, the 3rd or the 11th from the lord of the Dasa (Ketu).

metadata.sanskrit:
तथाऽष्टमन्यये भौमे दायेशाद्धनगेऽपि वा।
द्वृतं करोति मरणं विदेशे चापदं भ्रमम्।।४९॥
प्रमेहमूत्रकृच्छ्रदिचौरादिनृपपीडनम् ।
कलहादि व्यथायुक्तं किञ्चित्सुखविवर्द्धनम्।।४२॥

document: 41-42. There will be fear of death, disaster during a foreign journey, diabetes, unnecessary troubles, danger from thieves and the king and quarrels if Mars be in the 8th, the 12th or the 2nd from the lord of the Dasa (Ketu). In the above circumstances amidst evil effects there will be some auspicious effects also.

visits of close friends, happiness from employer, availability of sweetish preparations etc., will be derived in the Antardasa of Mercury in the Dasa of Venus, if Mercury be in kendra, trikona or the 11th from the Ascendant, (or from the lord of the Dasa Venus) in his sign of exaltation or in his own sign.

metadata.sanskrit:
दायेशात्षष्ठरुग्धे वा व्यये वा बलवर्जिते।
पापदृष्टे पापयुषते चतुष्पाज्जीवहानिकृत्।।६३।।
अन्यालयनिवासस्य मनोवैकल्यसम्भवः।
ध्यापारेषु च सर्वेषु हानिरेव न संशयः।।६४।।
मुक्त्यादो शोभनं प्रोक्तं मध्ये मध्यफलं विशेत्।
अन्ते क्लेशकरं चैव शीतवातज्वराविकम्।।६४।।

document: 63-65. If Mercury be in the 6th, the 8th or the 12th from the lord of Dasa (Venus) or be weak or be associated with a malefic, there will be agony, loss of cattle, residence in other people's houses, and losses in business. There will be some good effects at the commencement, more ate in the middle portion and distress from fever etc., at the end of the Antardasa.

metadata.sanskrit: सप्तमाधीशदोषेण देहपीडा **भवि**ष्यति । तद्दोषपरिहारार्थं विष्णुसाहस्नकं जपेत् ॥६६॥

document:
66. There will be physical distress if Mercury be the lord of the 2nd or the 7th from the Ascendant.
The remedial measure to obtain relief from the above evil effects, is recitation of Vishnu Sahasranama.
Effects of the Antardasa of Ketu in the Dasa of Venus

metadata.sanskrit:
शुक्रस्यान्तर्गते केतौ स्वोच्चे वा स्वर्क्षगेऽपि वा।
योगकारकसम्बन्धे स्थानवीर्यसमन्विते ॥ ६७॥
भुक्त्यादौ शुभमाधिक्यान्तित्यं मिष्ठान्नभोजनम् ।
ब्यवसायात्फलाधिक्यं गोमहिष्यादिवृद्धिकृत् ॥ ६८॥

document:
67-68. Auspicious effects like availability of sweetish preparations, abnormal gains in profession and increase in cattle wealth, will be derived from the very commencement of the Antardasa of Ketu in the Dasa of Venus, if Ketu be' in his
sign of exaltation, in his own sign or be related to a yogakaraka planet or be possessed of positional strength.
Notes: It is not laid down any where in which house does Ketu get positional strength.

metadata.sanskrit: > धनधान्यसमृद्धिश्च संवामे विजयो भवेत्। मुक्त्यन्ते हि सुखं चैव भुक्त्यावौ मध्यमं फलम्।।६६॥ मध्ये मध्ये महत्कच्टं पश्चादारोग्यमादिशेत्।।६६३॥

document: 69-69½. In the obove circumstances, there will be definite victory in the war at the end of the Antardasa. Moderate results will be experienced in the middle portion of the Antardasa and there will also be feeling of distress sometimes.

metadata.sanskrit: दायेशाद्रन्ध्रभावस्थे स्थये वा पापसंयुते ॥७०॥ चौराहित्रणपीडा च बुद्धिनाशो महद्भयम्। शिरोरुजं मनस्तापमकर्मकलहं बदेत्॥७१॥ प्रमेहभवरोगं च नानामार्गे धनव्ययः। भार्यापुत्रविरोधश्च गमनं कार्यनाशनम्॥७२॥

document: 70-72. There will be danger from snakes, thieves, wounds, loss of power of thinking, headache, agony, qurrels without any cause or reason, diabetes, excessive expenditure, antagonism with wife and children, going away to foreign land, loss in ventures, if Ketu be in the 8th or the 12th from the lord of the Dasa (Venus) or be associated with a malefic.

metadata.sanskrit: द्वितीयद्यननाथे तु देहवाघा मविष्यति । तद्दोषपरिहारार्थं मृत्युञ्जयजपं चरेत् ॥७३॥ छागदानं प्रकुर्वीत सर्वसम्पत्प्रदायकम् । शुक्रप्रीतिकरीं शान्ति ततः सुखमवाप्नुयात् ॥७४॥

document:
73-74. There will be physical distress if Ketu be the lord of the 2nd or the 7th from the Ascendant.
The remedial measures to obtain relief from the above effects are Mrityunjaya Japa ond giving a goat in charity.
Remedial measures for appeasing Venus will also prove beneficial.

metadata.sanskrit: अथ प्रत्यन्तर्दशाफलाध्याय: ॥६१॥

document:
1. By multiplying the years etc. of Antardasa of planets separately by Dasa years of each planet and dividing the product by total span of the Vimsottari Dasa, namely 120 years, we will arrive at the Pratyantar Dasa of each planet. Example: We have to find out the Pratyantar Dasa of the Sun in the Antardasa and Dasa of the Sun. The span of Antardasa namely 3 month 18 days converted into days comes to 108 days. The Pratyantar Dasa will be  $108 \times 6 = 648 \div 120$
= 5 days 24 ghatikas
The Pratyantar Dasa of the Moon in the Antardasa and, Dasa of the Sun will be  $108 \text{ days} \times 10 = 1080 \div 120 = 9 \text{ days}$
Tables are given below showing the Pratyantar Dasas of all the planets in the Antardasas in the Dasa of the Sun.

document: 2. Sun-Sun (This means P. Dasa of the Sun in the Antardasa of the Sun)—Argument with other persons, loss of wealth, distress to wife, headache etc. The above are general effects. Such inauspicious effects will not be produced if the Sun be in trikona etc., be the lord of an auspicious house, be in an auspicious house and a benefic varga. All other Pratyantar effects should be judged nothis manner.

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of Pratyantar Dasas in the Antardasa of Planets
metadata.sanskrit: (सू. चं.) उद्वेगः कलहश्चैव विलहानिर्मनोध्यथा। रध्यन्तरे विजानीयात् चन्द्रप्रत्यन्तरे फलम् ॥३॥

document: 4. Sun-Mars—Danger from the king and weapons, imprisonment, distress from enemies and fire.

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of Pratyantar Dasas in the Antardasa of Planets
metadata.sanskrit:
(सू. रा.) श्लेष्मव्याधिः शस्त्रभीतिर्धनहानिर्महद्भयम् । राजभङ्गस्तथा त्रासो राहुप्रत्यन्तरे फलम् ॥५॥ ् 5. Sun-Pahu—Disorder of phlegm, danger of weapons, loss of wealth, destruction of kingdom and mental agony.
(मू. गु.) शतुनाशो जयो वृद्धिर्वस्त्रहेमादिभूषणम् । अश्वयानादिलाभश्च गुरुप्रत्यन्तरे फलम् ॥६॥

document: 6. Sun-Jupiter-Victory, increase in wealth, gains of gold, garments, canveyances etc.

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of Pratyantar Dasas in the Antardasa of Planets
metadata.sanskrit: (सू. श.) धनहातिः पशेः पीडा महोद्वेगो महारुजः। अशुभं सर्वेभाष्नोति शनिप्रत्यन्तरे जनः॥७॥

document: 8. Sun-Mercury—Affectionate relations with kinsmen. availability of good food, gains of wealth, religious mindedness, reverence from the king (government).

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of Pratyantar Dasas in the Antardasa of Planets
metadata.sanskrit: (सू. के.) प्राणमीतिर्महाहानी राजभीतिश्च विग्रहः । श्रह्मणाञ्च महाबादो केतोः प्रत्यन्तरे भवेत् ॥६॥

document: 9. Sun-Ketu—Danger to life, loss of wealth, danger from the king (government) trouble with the enemies.

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of Pratyantar Dasas in the Antardasa of Planets
metadata.sanskrit: (सू. शु) दिनानि समरूपाणि लामोऽप्यत्पो भवेदिह। स्वत्पा च सुखसम्पत्तिः शुक्रप्रत्यन्तरे भवेत्॥१०॥

document: 10. Sun-Venus—Moderate effects or some gains of wealth may be expected.

document: Moon-Moon Acquisition of land, wealth and property, reverence from the king (government), and availability of sweetsh preparations.

metadata.chapter_title: Effects of Pratyantar Dasas in the Antardasa of Planets
metadata.sanskrit:
(चं. चं.) भूभोज्यधनसम्प्राप्ती राजपूजामहत्सुखम् । ाशस्चन्द्रान्तरे ज्ञेयं चन्द्रप्रत्यान्तरे फलम् ॥१९॥
(चं. मं.) मतिवृद्धिर्महापूज्यः सुखं बन्धुजनैः सह । धनागमः शत्रुभयं कुजप्रत्यन्तरे भवेत् ॥१२॥

document: 12. Moon-Mars—Wisdom and discretion, reverence from the people, increase in wealth, enjoyments to kinsmen but there will be danger from enemy.

metadata.sanskrit: (चं. रा.) भवेत्कत्याणसम्पत्ती राजवित्तसमागमः। अशुभैरल्पमृत्युश्च राहुप्रत्यान्तरे द्विज ! ॥१३॥

document: 13. Moon-Rahu—Well being and gain of wealth from the king (Government), danger of death if Rahu be associated with a malefic.

metadata.sanskrit: (सं. बृ.) वस्त्रलाभो महातेजो बह्यज्ञानं च सद्गुरोः। राज्यालंकरणावाप्तिर्गुक्प्रत्यन्तरे फलम्।।१४॥

document: 14. Moon-Jupiter—Enjoyments, increase in dignity and glory, gain of knowledge through the preceptor, acquisition of a kingdom (high position in Government) and gems etc.

metadata.sanskrit: (चं. श.) दुर्विने लभते पीडां वातपित्ताद्विशेषतः । धनधान्ययशोहानिः शनिप्रत्यन्तरे भवेत् ॥१५॥

document: 16. Moon-Mercury—Birth of a son, acquisition of a horse and other conveyances, success in education, progress, gain of white garments and grains.

metadata.sanskrit: (चं. के.) बाह्यणेत समं युद्धमपमृत्युः सुखक्षयः। सर्वत्र जायते क्लेशः केतोः प्रत्यन्तरे भवेत्।।१७॥

document: 17. Moon-Ketu—Quarrels with Brahmins, fear of premature death, loss of happiness, and distress all round.

metadata.sanskrit: (चं. शु.) धनलामो महत्सीस्थं कन्याजन्म सुभोजनम् । त्रोतिश्च सर्वलोकेम्यो भृगुप्रत्यन्तरे विधोः ॥१८॥

document: 18. Moon-Venus—Gain of wealth, enjoyments, birth of a daughter, availability of sweet [preparations and cordial relations with all.

metadata.sanskrit: (सं. सू.) अन्नागमो बस्त्रलामः शबुहानिः सुद्धागमः। सर्वत्र विजयप्राप्तिः सुर्यप्रत्यन्तरे विधोः॥१९॥

document: 19. Moon-Sun—Gain of happiness, grains and garments, victories every where.

document: 20. Mars-Mars—Danger from enemies, quarrels, and fear of premature death on account of blood diseases.

metadata.sanskrit: (मं रा.) बन्धनं राजभङ्गश्च धनहानिः कुभोजनम् । कलहः शत्रुभिनित्यं राहुप्रत्यन्तरे भवेत् ॥२१॥

document: 21. Mars-Rahu—Destruction of wealth and kingdom (fall of Government), unpalatable food and quarrels with the enemy.

metadata.sanskrit: (मं. गु.) मतिनाशस्तथा दुःखं सन्तापः कलहो भवेत्। विफलं चिन्तितं सर्वं गुरोः प्रत्यन्तरे भवेत्।।२२॥

document: 22. Mars-Jupiter—Loss of intelligence, distress, sorrows, quarrels and no-fulfilment of any ambition.

metadata.sanskrit: (मं. श.) स्वामिनाशस्तथा पीडा धनहानिर्महाभयम् । वैकल्यं कलहस्त्रासो शनेः प्रत्यन्तरे भवेत् ॥२३॥

document: 23. Mars-Saturn—Destruction of the employer, distress, loss of wealth, danger from enemies, anxiety, quarrels and sorrows.

metadata.sanskrit: (मं. बु.) सर्वथा बृद्धिनाशस्त्र धनहानिज्वरस्तनो । वस्त्रान्नसुहृदां नाशो बुधप्रत्यन्तरे भवेत् ॥२४॥

document: 24. Mars-Mercury—Loss of intelligence, loss of wealth. fevers and loss of grains, garments and friends.

metadata.sanskrit: (मं. के.) आलस्यं च शिरःपीडा पापरोगोऽपमृत्युकृत् । राजमीतिः शस्त्रघातो केतोः प्रत्यन्तरे भवेत् ॥२५॥

document: 25. Mars-Ketu--Distress from diseases, lethargy, premature death, danger from the king and weapons.

metadata.sanskrit: (मं. शु.) चाण्डालात्सङ्कटस्त्रासी राजशस्त्रभयं भवेत् । अतिसाराऽथ वमनं भृगोः प्रत्यन्तरे भवेत् ॥२६॥

document: 26. Mars-Venus—Distress from Chandals (चण्डाल), sorrows. danger from the king and weapons, dysentry and vomitting.

metadata.sanskrit: (मं. सू.) भूमिलाभोऽर्थसम्पत्तिः सन्तोषो मित्रसङ्गितिः। सर्वत्र सुखमाप्नोति रवेः प्रत्यन्तरे जनः॥२७॥

document: 27. Mars-Sun—Increase in landed property and wealth. satisfaction, visits of friends, happiness all round.

document: 34. Rahu-Venus—Danger from Yogini, danger from the king, loss of conveyances, availability of unpalatable food, loss of wife, sorrow in the family.

document: 35. Rahu-Sun—Danger from enemies, fevers, distress to children, fear of premature death, negligence.

metadata.sanskrit: (रा. चं.) उद्वेगकलहो चिन्ता मानहानिमंहद्भयम् । पितुर्विकलता देहे विधोः रवेः प्रत्यन्तरे भवेत ॥३६॥

document: 36. Rahu-Moon—Excitement, quarrels, worries, loss of reputation, fear, distress to father.

1. The Sookshmantar Dasa is arrived at by muliplying the periods of Pratyantar Dasa separately for each planet by the Dasa years of that planets and then by dividing the product by 120.
Example: Suppose we have to find out Sookshmantar Dasa of the Sun, in his own Dasa, in his Antardasa and in his Pratyantar Dasa. Dasa period of the Sun is 6 years, Pratyantar Dasa is 5/24 (5 days 24 ghatikas) or 324 ghatikas. The Sookshmantar Dasa will be  $324 \times 6 = 1944 \div 120 = 16$  ghatikas and 12 palas. The Sookshmantar Dasas of other planets may be calculated in the same manner.

document: 81. Venus-Mercury—Increase in wealth with the assistance of kinsmen, gain of wealth through business, happiness from wife and children.

metadata.sanskrit: (शु. के.) अग्निरोगो महापीडा मुखनेत्रशिरोब्यथा। सञ्चितार्थात्मनः पीडा भृगोः सूक्ष्मगते ध्वजे ॥५२॥

document:
82. Venus-Ketu—Danger from fire, distress from diseases, distress in mouth, eyes and forehead, loss of accumulated wealth, mental agony. Notes: It will be noted from the description of effects in Sookshma Dasas that generally, the effects of Sookshma Dasas of malefics in the Pratyantar Dasas of benefics are not favourable and those of benefics in the Pratyantar Dasas of malefics are favourable. If the Pratyantar dasa and Sookshma Dasa both are favourable, there will be special auspiciousness in effects and if the both are unfavourable, there will be more inauspiciousness in effects. 1. If we multiply the Sookshma Dasa spans by the Dasa years of each planet and divide the product by 120, we will get the Prana Dasa.
Example: The Sookshma Dasa of the Sun is 16 ghatikas and 12 palas or 972 palas. The Prana Dasa of the Sun in his own Sookshma Dasa will be—
 $972 \times 6 = 5832 \div 120 = 48$  palas and 36 vipalas.
Thus 48 palas and 36 vipalas will be Prana Dasa in the Sookshma Dasa of the Sun in his Pratyantar Dasa, Antardasa and Dasa.

metadata.sanskrit: (सू. बु.) राजान्नभोगः सततं राजलाञ्छानतत्पदम् । आत्मा सन्तर्पयेदेवं रवेः प्राणगेते बुधे ॥६॥

document: 8. Sun-Mercury—Feeding from the king's kitchen, acquisition of Chhatra and Chamar with royal symbols, attainment of the position of a high dignitary of government.

metadata.sanskrit: (सू. के.) अन्योऽन्यं कलहश्चैव वसुहानिः पराजयः। गुरुस्त्रीबन्धुवर्गेश्च सूर्यप्राणगते ध्वजे ॥६॥

document: 9. Sun-Ketu—Loss of wealth due to quarrels with the preceptor (or elders), wife and kinsmen.

metadata.sanskrit: (स्. शु.) राजपूजा धनाधिक्यं स्त्रीपुत्रादिभयं सुखम्। अन्नपानादिभोगादि सूर्यप्राणगते भृगौ ॥१०॥

document:
10. Sun-Venus—Recognition or reverence from the king, increase in wealth, happiness from wife and children, enjoyments from eating and drinking.
Effects of Prana Dasas in the Sookshma Dasa of the Moon
- 11. Moon-Moon—Happiness from wife and children, gain of wealth and clothes, yoga sidhi (योग सिद्धि).

metadata.sanskrit:
- (चं. चं.) स्त्रीपुत्रादिसुखं द्रश्यं सभते नूतनाम्बरम् । योगसिद्धि समाधिञ्च निजप्राणगते विधौ ॥११॥
(चं. मं.) क्षयं कुळं बन्धुनाशं रक्तस्रावान्महद्भयम्। भूतावेशादि जायेत विधोः प्राणगते कुजे।।१२।।

document: 12. Moon-Mars—Consumption, leprosy, destruction of kinsmen, bleeding, creation of turbulence by friends and goblins (evil spirits).

metadata.sanskrit: (चं. रा.) सर्पभीतिविशेषेण भूतोपद्ववान् सदा। दृष्टिक्षोभो मतिम्नंशो विद्योः प्राणगतेऽप्यगौ ॥१३॥

document: 13. Moon-Rahu—Danger from snakes, creation of turbulence by evil spirits, weakness of eye sight, confusion of mind.
- 14. Moon-Jupiter—Growth of religious mindedness, forgiveness, devotion towards deities and Brahmins, good fortune, meeting with near and dear ones.

metadata.sanskrit: (चं. बृ.) धर्मवृद्धिः क्षमाप्राप्तिबेंबब्राह्मणपूजनम् । सौभाग्यं प्रियवृद्धिश्च चन्द्रप्राणगते गुरौ ॥१४॥

document: - 15. Moon-Saturn—Unexpected and sudden physical distress, creation of troubles by enemies, weakness of eye sight, gain of wealth.

metadata.sanskrit: - (चं श.) सहसा देहपतनं शत्रूपद्रववेदना। अन्धत्वं च धनप्राप्तिश्चन्द्रप्राणगते शनौ॥१५॥

document:
- 16. Moon-Mercury—Gift of Chamar and Chhatra by the king, acquisition of a kingdom, even mindedness in people.
- 17. Moon-Ketu—Danger from weapons, fire, the enemy and poison, stomach troubles, separation from wife and children.

metadata.sanskrit:
- (चं बु.) चामरच्छत्रसम्प्राप्ती राज्येलाभो नृपात्ततः। समत्वं सर्वभूतेषु चन्द्रप्राणगते बुधे।।१६॥
- (चं. के.) शस्त्राग्निरिपुजा पीडा विचाग्निः कुक्षिरोगिता।
  पुत्रदारवियोगश्च चन्द्रप्राणगते ध्वजे ॥१७॥

document: - 18. Moon-Venus—Acquisition of friends and wife (marriage), gain of wealth from foreign lands, all kinds of enjoyments.

metadata.sanskrit: - (चं. शु.) पुत्रमित्रकलत्नाप्तिविदेशाच्च धनागमः । सुखसम्पत्तिरर्थश्च चन्द्रप्राणनतः भृगौ ॥१८॥

document:
- 19. Moon-Sun—Brutality, increase in anger, fear of death, agony, going away from the homeland, dangers.
- Effects of the Prana Dasas in the Sookshma Dasa of Mars

metadata.sanskrit: - (चं. सू.) कूरता कोपवृद्धिश्च प्राणहानिर्मनोय्यथा। देशत्यागो महाभीतिश्चन्द्रप्राणगते रवौ ॥१६॥

document: - 20. Mars-Mars—Quarrels with the enemy, imprisonment, bilious and blood pollution troubles.

metadata.sanskrit:
- (मं. मं.) कलहो रिपुभिर्बन्धः रक्तपितादिरोगभीः । निजसूक्ष्मदशामध्ये कृज प्राणगते फलम् ॥२०॥
- (मं. रा.) विच्युतः सुतदारैश्च बन्ध्र्पद्रवपीडितः। प्राणत्यागो विषेणव भौमप्राणगतेऽप्यहौ ॥२१॥

document: 21. Mars-Rahu—Separation from wife and children, distress as a result of oppression by kinsmen, fear of death, poison.

metadata.sanskrit: (मं. षु.) देवार्चनपरः श्रीमान्मन्त्रानुष्ठानतत्परः । पुत्रपौत्रसुकावाप्तिभौ मत्राणगते गुरौ ॥२२॥

document: 22. Mars-Jupiter—Devotion towards deities, gain of wealth, competence in mantra rituals.

metadata.sanskrit: (मं. श.) अग्निबाधा भवेन्मृत्युरर्थनाशः पदच्युतिः । बन्धुभिर्बन्धुतावाप्तिभौ मप्राणगते शनौ ॥२३॥

document: 23. Mars-Saturn—Danger from fire, death, loss of wealth, loss of position but good relations with kinsmen.

metadata.sanskrit: (मं. बु.) विश्याम्बरसमुत्यत्तिविध्याभरणभूषितः । विध्याङ्गनायाः सम्प्राप्तिभौ मप्राणगते बुधे ॥२४॥

document: 25. Mars-Ketu—Fear of falling down from a high place, eye troubles, danger from snakes, loss of reputation.

metadata.sanskrit: (मं. शु.) धनधान्यादिसम्पत्तिर्लोकपूजा सुखागमा । नानाभोगमंबेद्मोगी मौमप्राणगते भूगौ ॥२६॥

document: 26. Mars-Venus—Gain of wealth, reverence amongst people (popularity), enjoyment of many kinds of luxuries.

metadata.sanskrit: (मं. सू.) ज्वरोन्मादः क्षयोऽर्थस्य राजविस्नेहसम्भवः। बीर्घरोगी दृरिद्रः स्यादभौमप्राणगते रवौ।।२७॥

document:
28. Mars-Moon—Comforts of good food and garments, distress from heat and cold.
Effects of Prana Dasas in the Sookshma Dasa of Rahu

metadata.sanskrit: (रा. रा.) अन्नाशने विरक्तश्च विषमीतिस्तथैव च । पाहसाद्धननाशश्च राहौ प्राणगते नर्वत् ॥२१॥

document: 29. Rahu-Rahu-Loss of taste in eating, danger from poison, loss of wealth through rashness.

metadata.sanskrit: (रा. बृ,) अङ्गसीख्यं विनिर्मीतिर्वाह्महोत्त्व सङ्गता । नीचैः कलहसम्प्राप्ती राहोः धाणगते गुरौ ॥३०॥

document: 30. Rahu-Jupiter—Physical well being, fearlessness, gain of conveyance and quarrels witn menials.

metadata.sanskrit: (रा. श.) गृहदाहः शरीरे रुङ् नीचैरपहृत धनम्। तथा बन्धनसम्प्राप्ती राहोः प्राणगते शनौ॥३१॥

document: 31. Rahu-Saturn—Danger from fire, diseases, loss of wealth through meniols, imprisonment.

metadata.sanskrit: (रा. बु.) गुरूपदेशविभवो गुरुसत्कारवर्द्धनम् । गुणवाञ्छीलवांश्चापि राहोः प्राणगते बुधे ॥३२॥

document: 32. Rahu-Mercury—Devotion towards the preceptor and increase of wealth through his beneficience, good qualities and well cultured.

metadata.sanskrit: (रा. के.) स्त्रीपुत्राविविरोधश्च गृहान्निष्क्रमणादपि । साहसात्कायहानिश्च राहोः प्राणगते ध्वजे ।।३३।।

document: 33. Rahu-Ketu—Antagonism with wife and children, going away from home, loss of wealth through rashness.

metadata.sanskrit:
(रा. शु.) छत्रवाहनसम्पत्तिः सर्वार्थफलसञ्चयः। शिवार्चनगृहारम्भो राहोः प्राणगते मृगौ ॥३४॥ 34. Rahu-Venus—Acquisition of Chhatra, Chamar, conveyances etc., success in all ventures, worship of Lord Shiva, construction of a house.
(रा. सू.) अशांविरोगभीतिश्च राज्योपद्रवसम्भवः । चतुष्पादादिहानिश्च राहोः प्राणगते रवौ ॥३५॥

document: 36. Rahu-Moon—Development of mental powers and intelligence, popularity, visits of preceptors (elders), danger of committing sins.

metadata.sanskrit: (रा. मं.) चाण्डालाग्निवशाद्भीतिः स्वपदश्युतिरापदः मलिनः श्वादिवृत्तिश्च राहोः प्राणगते कुज ॥३७॥

document:
37. Rahu-Mars—Dangers from menials and fire, loss of position, disaster, filthiness and meanness.
Effects of Prana Dasas in the Sookshma Dasa of Jupiter

metadata.sanskrit: (बृ. बृ.) हर्षागमो धनाधिक्यमग्निहोतं शिवार्चनम् । बाहनं छत्रसंयुक्तं निज प्राणगते गुरौ ॥३८॥

document: 38. Jupiter-Jupiter—Happiness, increase in wealth, performance of havana, worship of Lord Shiva, acquisition of Chhatra and conveyances.

- 39. Jupiter-Saturn—Failure in fasting, unhappiness, going away to foreign lands, loss of wealth, antagonism with kinsmen.
- 40. Jupiter-Mercury—Progress in education, increase in intelligence, happiness to wife and children, popularity, gain of wealth.

metadata.sanskrit:
(बृ. श.) व्रतहानिविषादश्च विदेशे धननाशनम्। विरोधो बन्धुवर्गैश्च गुरोः प्राणगते शनौ।।३६॥
- (बृ.बु.) विद्याबुद्धिविवृद्धिश्च लोके पूजा धनागमः। स्त्रीपुद्धादिसुखप्राप्तिर्गुरोः प्राणगते बुधे॥४०॥

document: - 41. Jupiter Ketu—Opulence and glory, learnedness, gain of knowledge of Shastras, worship of Lord Shiva, performance of havana, devotion towards preceptor.

metadata.sanskrit: - (बृ. के.) ज्ञानं विमयपाण्डित्यं शास्त्रज्ञानं शिवार्चनम् । अग्निहोत्रं गुरोभंक्तिर्गुरोः प्राणगते ध्वजे ॥४९॥

document: - 42. Jupiter-Venus—Freedom from diseases, enjoyments, increase in wealth, happiness from wife and children.

metadata.sanskrit: - (मृ. शु.) रोगान्मुदितः सुखं भोगो धनधान्यसमानमः। पुत्रदारादिजं सौद्यं गुरोः प्राणगते भृगौ॥४२॥

document: - 43. Jupiter-Sun—Disorder of wind, bile and phlegm, pains due to disorders of juices in the body.

metadata.sanskrit: - (बृ. सू.) वातिपत्तप्रकोपं च श्लेष्मोद्रेकं तु दारुणम् । रसध्याधिकृतं शूलं गुरोः प्राणगते रवौ ॥४३॥

document: - 44. Jupiter-Moon—Acquisition of Chhatra with royal symbol, opulence and glory, increase in children, eye and stomach troubles.

metadata.sanskrit: - (बृ. चं.) छत्रचामरसंयुक्तं बैभवं पुत्रसम्पदः। नेत्रकृक्षिगता पीडा गुरोः प्राणगते विधौ॥४४॥

document: - 45. Jupiter-Mars—Danger of administration of poison by wife, imprisonment, foreign journeys, confusion of mind.

metadata.sanskrit: - (बृ. मं.) स्त्रीजनाच्च विषोत्पत्तिर्बधनं चातिनिग्रहः । देशान्तरगमो भ्रान्तिर्गुरोः प्राणगते कुजे ॥४५॥

document:
- 46. Jupiter-Rahu—Distress from diseases, troubles from thieves, danger from snakes, scorpions etc.
Effects of Prant Dasas in the Sookshma Dasa of Saturn

metadata.sanskrit: - (बृ. रा.) व्याधिभिः परिभूतः स्याच्चौरैरपहृतं धनम्। सर्पवृश्चिकभीतिश्च गुरोः प्राणगतेऽप्यहौ ॥४६॥

document: - 47. Saturn-Saturn—Loss of lustre due to fevers, leprosy, stomach troubles, danger of death from fire.

metadata.sanskrit: - (श. श.) ज्वरेण ज्वलिता कान्तिः कुष्टरोगोदरादिरक्। जलाग्निकृतमृत्यः स्यान्तिजप्राणगते शनौ ॥४७॥

document: - 48. Saturn-Mc cury—Gain of wealth and grains, profits in business, revenece, devotion towards deities and Brahmins.

metadata.sanskrit: - (श. बु.) धनं धान्यं च माङ्गल्यं व्यवहाराभिपूजनम् । वेवसाह्यणमन्तिरच शनेः प्राणगते बुधे ॥४८॥

document: - 49. Saturn-Ketu—Death like distress, creation of turbulence by evil spirits, insult from a woman other than wife.

metadata.sanskrit: - (श. के.) मृत्युवेदनदुःखं च भूतोपद्रवसम्भवः। परदाराभिभूतत्वं शनेः प्राणगते ध्वजे ॥४६॥

document: - 50. Saturn-Venus—Enjoyments through wealth, son and beneficience of the king, performance of havanas, marriage etc.

metadata.sanskrit: - (श. शु.) पुतार्थविभवैः सौख्यं क्षितिपालावितः सुखम् । अग्निहोत्रं विवाहश्य शनेः प्राणगते भृगौ ॥५०॥

document: - 51. Saturn-Sun—Troubles in the eyes and forehead, danger from snakes and enemies, loss of wealth, distress.

metadata.sanskrit: - (श. सू.) अक्षिपीडा शिरोव्याधिः सर्पशत्नुभयं भवेत् । अर्थहानिर्महाक्लेशः शनैः प्राणगते रवौ ॥५१॥

document: - 52. Saturn-Moon—Sound health, birth of a son, relief, thriving strength, devotion towards deities and Brahmins.

metadata.sanskrit: - (श. चं.) आरोग्यं पुत्रलाभश्च शान्तिपौष्टिकवर्धनम्। देवबाह्यणभक्तिश्च शनेः प्राणगते विधौ॥५२॥

document: - 53. Saturn-Mars—Affliction with Gulma disease, danger from enemy, danger of death during hunting, danger from snakes, fire and poison.

metadata.sanskrit: - (श. मं.) गुल्मरोगः शब्रुभीतिर्मृ गया प्राणनाशनम् । सर्पाग्निबबती मीतिः शनैः प्राणगते कुजे ॥५३॥

document: - 54. Saturn-Rahu—Going away from homeland, danger from the king, bewitchment. taking of poison, troubles from wind and bile.

metadata.sanskrit: - (श. रा ) देशत्यागो नृपाद्भीतिर्मीहनं विषभक्षणम् । वातपित्तकृता पीडा शनेः प्राणगतेऽप्यहौ ॥५४॥

document:
- 55. Saturn-Jupiter—Attainment of the position of a Commander in the army, gain of land, association with ascetics, reverence from the king.
Effects of Prana Dasas in the Sookshma Dasa of Mercury

metadata.sanskrit: - (श. बृ.) सेनापत्यं भूमिलाभः संगमः स्वजनेः सह। गौरवं नृपसम्मानं शनेः प्राणगते गुरौ॥४४॥

document: - 56. Mercury-N cury-Increase in enjoyments, wealth and religious mindedness, even mindedness in all living beings.

metadata.sanskrit: - (बु. बु.) आरोग्यं सुखसम्पत्तिर्धमंकर्मादिसाधनम् । समत्वं र्भूतेषु निजन्नाणगते बुधे ॥५६॥

document: - 58. Mercury-Venus—Supermacy over others, increase in wealth, reputation and religious mindedness, devotion to Lord Shiva, happiness from son.

metadata.sanskrit: - (बु. शु.) प्रभुत्वं धनसम्पत्तिः कीर्तिधर्मः शिवार्चनम् । पुत्रदारादिकं सौख्यं बुधप्राणगते भूगौ ॥५८॥

document: - 59. Mercary-Sam—Agony, fevers, lunacy, affectionate relations with wife and kinsmen, receipt of stolen property.

metadata.sanskrit: - (बु. सू) अन्तर्दाहो ज्वरोन्मादौ बान्धवानां रति स्त्रियाः। प्राप्यते स्तेयसम्पत्तिर्बुधप्राणगते रवौ ॥५६॥

document: - 60. Mercury-Moon—Happiness from wife, birth of a daughter, gain of wealth, and enjoyments all round.

metadata.sanskrit: - (बु. चं.) स्त्रीलाभरवार्षसम्पत्तिः कन्यालाभो धनागमः। लभते सर्वतः सौढ्यं बुधप्राणगते विद्यौ॥६०॥

document: - 61. Mercury-Mars—Tendency to indulge in nefarious activities, pain in eyes, teeth and stomach, piles, danger from death.

metadata.sanskrit: - (बु. मं.) पतितः कृष्टिकोगी **च र**न्तनेत्रादिजा व्यथा। अशांति प्रजासन्देही बुधप्राणगते कुजे॥६१॥

document: - 52. Mercury-Rahu—Gain of clothes, ornaments and wealth, separation from own people, antagonism with Brahmins delirium.

metadata.sanskrit: - (बु. रा.) अल्लाजरणसम्पत्तिवियोगो विप्रवेरिता। सन्तिपातोव्भवं दुवं बुधप्राणगतेऽप्यहौ ॥६२॥

document: - 63. Mercury-Jupiter—Sublimity, progress in education, increase in wealth and good qualities, profits in business.

metadata.sanskrit: - (बु. गु.) गुरुत्वं धनसम्पत्तिविद्या सद्गुणसंग्रहः । व्यवसायेन सल्लाको बुखप्राणगते गुरौ ॥६३॥

document:
- 64. Mercury-Saturn—Danger of death from thieves, poverty, beggary.
- Effects of Prana Dasas in the Sookahma Dasa of Ketu

metadata.sanskrit: - (बु. श.) चौर्येण निधनप्राप्तिबिञ्चनत्वं दरिद्रता। याचकत्वं विशेषेण बुखब्राणगते शनौ॥६४॥

document: - 65. Kets-Kets—Danger of fall from a conveyance, quarrels with the enemy, committing a murder inadvertently.

metadata.sanskrit:
- (के. के.) अरवपातेन भातरच शत्रुतः कलहागमः। निविधारबधील्पत्तिनिखप्राण्यते व्यक्ते॥६४॥
(के. शु.) क्षेत्रलाभी वैरिनाशो हयलामो मनःसुखम् । पशुक्षेत्रधनाप्तिश्च केतोः प्राकाते मृगौ ॥६६॥

document: 66. Ketu-Venus—Gain of land and conveyance, happiness, destruction of enemy, increase in cattle wealth.

metadata.sanskrit: (के, सू.) स्तेयाग्निरियुपीतिश्व धनहानिर्मनोव्यथा। प्राणान्तकरणं कष्टं केतोः प्राणगते रवौ॥६७॥

document: 67. Ketu-Sun—Danger from fire and enemy, loss of wealth, mental agony, death like suffering.

metadata.sanskrit: (के. चं.) देवद्विजगुरोः पूजा दीर्घयात्राः धनं सुखम्। कणं वा लोखने रोगः केतोः प्राणगः विद्यो ॥६८॥

document: 68. Ketu-Moon—Devotion towards deities and Brahmins, journeys to distant places, gain of wealth and happiness, eye and ear troubles.

metadata.sanskrit: (के. मं.) पित्तरोगो नसावृद्धिविश्वमः सन्तिपातजः। स्वबन्धुजनविद्वेषः केतोः प्राणगते कुजे।।६६।।

document: 69. Ketu-Mars—Bilious troubles, enlargement of veins, deleriun, antagonism with kinsmen.

metadata.sanskrit: (के. रा.) विरोधः स्त्रीसुताद्यश्च गृहान्तिष्क्रमणं भवेत्। स्वसाहसात्कार्यहानिः केतोः प्राणगतेऽप्यहौ ॥७०॥

document: 70. Ketu-Rahu—Antagonism with son and wife, going away from home, loss in ventures due to rashness.

metadata.sanskrit: (के. वृ.) शस्त्रवर्णर्महारोगो हृत्पीडादिसमुद्भवः । सुतदारवियोगश्च केतोः प्राणगते गुरौ ॥७१॥

document: 71. Ketu-Jupiter—Injuries from weapons, wounds, heart disease, separation from wife and children.

metadata.sanskrit: (के. श.) मितविभ्रमतीक्ष्णत्वं भूरकर्मरितः सदा । व्यवसनाद्वन्धनं दुःखं केतोः प्राणगते शनौ ॥७२॥

document: 72. Ketu-Satura—Confusion of mind, tendencies towards nefarious deeds, imprisonment on account of addictions (in drugs etc.), distress.

metadata.sanskrit: (के. बु.) कुसुमं शयनं भूषा लेपनं मोजनादिकम्। सौस्यं सर्वाङ्गभोग्यं च केतोः प्राणगते बुधे।।७३॥

document:

document: 78. Venus-Rahu—Distress from enemy, eye and stomach troubles, antagonism with friends.

metadata.sanskrit: (शु. वृ.) आयुरारोग्यमेश्वर्यं पुतस्त्रीधनवंभवम् । छत्रवाहनसंप्राप्तिः शुक्रप्राणगते गुरौ ॥७६॥

document: 79. Venus-Jup. —Good longevity, sound health, happiness from wealth, wife nd children, acquisition of chhatra and conveyances.

metadata.sanskrit: (शु. श.) राजोपद्रवजा भीतिः सुखहानिर्महारुजः। भीतैः सह विवादरच भूगोः प्राणगते शनौ ॥५०॥

document: 80. Venus-Saturn—Danger from the king, loss of happiness, critical disease, controversy with menials.

metadata.sanskrit: (शु. बु.) सन्तोषो राजसम्मानं नानादिग्मूमिसम्पदः । नित्यमुत्साहबृद्धिः स्याच्छुत्रज्ञाणगते बुधे ॥६१॥

document: 81. Venus-Mercury—Satisfaction, reverence from the king, gains of land and wealth from many directions, increase in enthusiasm.

metadata.sanskrit: (शु. के.) जीवितात्मयशोहानिर्धन-धान्य-परिक्षयः । त्यागमोगधनानि स्युः शुक्रप्राणगते ध्वजे ।। ५२॥

document: 82. Venus-Ketu—Loss of life, wealth, and reputation, only some money is left for charities and sustenance.

document: 83. The reverred Sage Parasara said—O Brahmin! here I have described to you the effects of Nakshatra (Vimsottari) Dasas etc. The good or adverse predictions should be made after assessing judiciously the auspiciousness and inauspiciousness of all the five, namely Dasa, Antardasa, Pratyantar Dasa, Sookshma Dasa and Prana Dasa.

1. The Sage said—Now I am going to describe to you the effects of Antardasas in the Kalachakra Dasa as related by Lord Shiva to the Goddess Parvati. document: 2. Dasa of Art. Imsa—There will be wounds and fever in the Antardasa of Mars (that is Aries or Scorpio) in the Dasa of Aries Amsa. In the same Dasa and Antardasa of the Rasis owned by Mercury, Venus, Moon and Jupiter all kinds of happiness will be enjoyed. Danger from enemy will be experienced in the Antardasa of the Sun.

metadata.sanskrit:
वृषांशं स्वान्तरे सौरे कलहो रोगसम्भवः।
विद्यालाभस्तनों सोख्यं गुरौ तत्र गते फलम्।।३।।
देशत्यागो मृतिर्वापि शस्त्रघातो ज्वरोऽथवा।
वृषभस्वांशके वित्र! कुजे तत्र गते फलम्।।४।।
वस्त्राभरणलाभश्च स्त्रीसुयोगो महत् सुखम्।
शुक्रेन्दुसुत-चन्द्रेषु वृषभस्वांशके फलम्।।४।।

document: 3-5. Dasa of Taurus Amsa—Effects like quarrels, diseases will be experienced in Antardasa of Saturn (that is Capricorn or Aquarius). There will be gains of education and physical felicity in the Antardasa of Jupiter (Sagittarius or Pisces), going away from home, death or distress from fevers in the Antardasa of Mars (Aries and Scorpio) and gains of garments, happy association with women in the Antardasas of the rasis owned by Venus and Mercury. Danger from the king and violent animals may be expected in the Antardasa of rasi (Leo) owned by the Sun.

metadata.sanskrit:
नृपाद् भयं पितृमृतिः स्ववदाद्यभयं रवौ।
मिथुने स्वांशके शुक्षे धनः स्वतसमागमः ॥६॥
पितृमातृमृतेर्भीतिर्ज्वरस्य न्नणसम्भवः।
दूरदेशप्रयाणं च मियुने स्वांशके कुजे॥७॥
बुद्धि-विद्या-विवृद्धिरस्य महाविभवसम्भवः।
लोके मानरस्य प्रीतिरस्य मिथुने स्वांशके गुरौ ॥६॥
विदेशसमनं व्याधिर्मरणं धननाशनम्।
वन्धुनाशोऽयवा विप्र! मिथुने स्वांशके शनौ ॥६॥
विद्यावस्त्रादिलाभश्च वारपुत्राविजं सुखम्।
सर्वत्र मानमाप्नोति मिथुने स्वांशके बुधे॥१०॥

document:
6-10. Dasa of Gemini Amsa—The effects in the Antardasas of the rasis concerned will be as follows—
Venus (Taurus or Libra)—Gain of wealth and garments.
Mars (Aries and Scorpio)—Death of parents, danger, fever, wounds and travels to distant places.
Jupiter (Sagittarius or Pisces)—Increase in intelligence, success in education, opulence and glory, popularity and affection towards others.
Saturn (Capricorn or Aquarius)—Foreign journeys, diseases, fear of death, loss of wealth and kinsmen.
Mercury (Gemini or Virgo)—Success in education, gains of garments etc., happiness from the wife and children and reverence from all quarters.

metadata.sanskrit:
कर्क स्वांशगते चन्द्रे पुत्रदारसुखं महत्।
ऐश्वर्यं लमते लोके मानं प्रीति तथेष च ॥११॥
शातुभ्यश्च पशुभ्यश्च भयं राजकुलात् तथा।
आधिव्याधिभयं चेव कर्के स्वांशगते रवौ॥१२॥
पुत्र-दार-सुहृत्सौख्यं धनवृद्धिस्तथेव च।
लोके मानं यशश्चैव कर्कांशे बृध-शुक्रयोः॥१३॥
विषशस्त्रभृतेभीति ज्वररोगादि-सम्भवाम्।
पीडां चेव समाप्नोति कर्के स्वांशगते कुजे॥१४॥
विभवस्यातिलाभश्च शरीरेऽपि सुखं तथा।
नृपात् सम्मानलाभश्च कर्के स्वांशगते गुरौ॥१४॥
बातव्याधिमयं घोरं सर्पवृश्चिकतो भयम्।
नानाकव्यस्वाप्नोति कर्के स्वांशगते शनौ॥१६॥

document:
11-16. Dasa of Cancer Amsa—The effects in the various Antardasas of the rasis concerned will be as follows—
Moon (Cancer)—Happiness from wife and children, gain of wealth and reverence from the public (popularity).
Sun (Leo)—Danger from enemies, animals and the royal family, mental agony and fear of diseases.
Mercury (Gemini or Virgo) and Venus (Taurus and Libra)—Happiness from wife, children and friends, increase in wealth, popularity and name and fame.
Mars (Aries or Scorpio)—Danger from poison, weapons and diseases like fever.
Jupiter (Sagittarius or Pisces)—Gains of wealth, physical felicity, honours from the king.
Saturn (Capricorn or Aquarius)—Rheumatism, danger from anskes, scorpions and distress of all kinds.

metadata.sanskrit:
सिहांशे स्वांशगे भौमे मुखरोगभयं दिशेत्।
पित्तज्वरकृतां बाद्यां शस्त्रक्षतमथापि वा ॥१७॥
धनवस्त्रादिलाभश्च स्त्रीपृतादिसुखं तथा।
वृधभागंवयोवित्र! सिहांशे स्वान्तरस्थयोः॥१८॥
उच्चात् पतनभीतिश्च स्वल्पद्रव्यसमागमः।
विदेशगमनं चैव सिहे स्वान्तर्गते विद्यौ॥१६॥
भयं शत्रुजनेभ्यश्च ज्वरादिव्याधिसम्भवः।
भानहानिमृतभीतिः सिहे स्वान्तर्गते रवौ॥२०॥
धनद्यान्यादिलाभं च प्रसादं द्विज-भूष्योः।
विद्यावृद्धिमवाप्नोति सिहे स्वान्तर्गते गुरौ॥२९॥

document:
17-21. Dasa of Leo Amsa—The effects in the various Antardasas of rasis concerned will be as follows—
Mars (Aries and Scorpio)—Diseases of the mouth, bilious fever and danger from weapon. Mercury (Gemini or Virgo), Venus (Taurus and Libra)—Gain of clothes, happiness from wife and children. Moon (Cancer)—Danger from fall from some height, meagre gains of wealth, foreign journeys. Sun (Leo)—Danger from enemies, fevers, loss of wisdom, fear of death. Jupiter (Sagittarius or Pisces)—Gains of wealth and grains, beneficence of the king and Brahmins, progress in education. Notes: The effects which are being described here are of the Antardasas of the rasis concerned. Their lords have been mentioned because they (rasis) yield effects according to the characteristics of their lords.

metadata.sanskrit:
कन्यायां स्वांशगे सौरे कव्टं प्राप्नोति मानवः।
द्रयाणं च ज्वरं चैव क्षुद्भवं वैक्लवं तथा॥२२॥
नृपप्रसादमैश्वर्यं सुद्दृद्वन्धुसमागमम्।
विद्यावृद्धिमवाप्नोति कन्यायां स्वांशके गुरौ॥२३॥
पित्तज्वरभवा पीडा विदेशे गमनं तथा।
शस्त्रघातोऽग्निभोतिश्च कन्यायां स्वान्तरे कुले॥२४॥
भृत्य-पुत्रार्थलाभश्च नानामुखसमागमः।
बुधभार्गवचन्द्रेषु कन्यास्वांशगतेषु च॥२५॥
प्रयाणं रोगभोतिश्च कलहो बन्धुनिः सह।
शस्त्रघातभयं चैव कन्यांशे स्वांशगे रवो॥२६॥

document: For example, when we describe effects of the Antardasa of Jupiter, it means that the effects are of the Antardasas of rasis owned by Jupiter, namely Sagittarius and Pisces. This clarification has been given so that there may be no confusion in the mind of the readers.

22-26. Dasa of Virgo Amsa—The effects in the various Antardasas of the rasis concerned will be as follows—
Saturn (Capricorn or Aquarius)—Many kinds of troubles, travels to distant places, fevers, distress from hunger.
Jupiter (Sagittarius or Pisces)—Gains of wealth through the beneficence of the king, arrival of friends and kinsmen and success in education.
Mars (Aries or Scorpio)—Bilious fever, travels to distant places, danger from fire and weapons.
Mercury (Gemini or Virgo), Venus (Taurus and Libra) and Moon (Cancer)—Gains of wealth through sons and employees, many enjoyments.
Sun (Leo)—Travel to distant lands, danger from diseases, quarrels with kinsmen, danger of assaults by weapons.

metadata.sanskrit:
तुले स्वान्तगंते शुके सद्बुद्धिश्च सुखोवयः।
स्त्रीपुत्रधन-वस्त्रादिलाभो भवति निश्चितः॥२७॥
पितृकव्टं सुहृद्वेरं शिरोरोगो ज्वरोदयः।
विषशस्त्राग्निभीतिश्च तुले स्वान्तगते कुजे॥२८॥
